theme_and_archetype.description: Functional, clean, high-contrast B2B SaaS dashboard tailored for pure HTML/CSS/PHP. Emphasizes clarity for dense data (Gantt charts, tables) over decoration. Minimalist look with distinct structural lines.

typography.implementation_notes: Import via Google Fonts. Use semantic tags (h1-h6).

colors.description: High-contrast structural grayscale with sharp actionable accents.

layout_and_spacing.description: Use CSS variables for consistent padding and gaps. Emphasize whitespace even in dense data views.
general_rules: Sidebar: Fixed width, transition width on collapse using purely JS toggling a class.
Main Content: Margin-left equal to sidebar width, smooth transition.
Dashboard Bento Grid: Use CSS Grid with gap-6, auto-fit or specific column spans for KPIs.

buttons.rules: Border-radius 6px. Padding 8px 16px. Font-weight 500. Transition background and transform on hover. Primary button is dark slate (--accent-primary).

cards.rules: Background white, 1px solid --border-light, border-radius 8px, padding 24px. No heavy drop shadows; use structural borders instead.

rules: Layout: Use a CSS Grid or Table with sticky first column (Rooms) and sticky top row (Dates).
Cell Sizing: Minimum width 60px per day, height 50px for generous click targets.
Booking Bars: Positioned absolutely inside cells, spanning multiple days using width calculations. Border-radius 4px, padding 4px 8px, distinct background colors based on status.
Hover state: Slight brightness increase on booking bars, show a CSS tooltip or JS-driven popover.
Wrapper: overflow-x: auto, border 1px solid --border-light, border-radius 8px.
Th/Td: Padding 12px 16px, text-align left, border-bottom 1px solid --border-light.
Headers (Th): Sticky top, background white, font-weight 600, font-size 0.75rem, text-transform uppercase, color --text-secondary.
Badges: For statuses. Inline-flex, padding 2px 8px, border-radius 999px, font-size 0.75rem.
Overlay: Fixed inset-0, bg-black/50, backdrop-blur-sm, z-40, display none by default.
Panel: Fixed top-0, right-0, bottom-0, width 400px, background white, z-50, transform translateX(100%), transition transform 0.3s ease.
Forms inside drawer: Clean layout, group inputs with labels, generous spacing (--space-4) between form groups.

icons.rules: Replace all emojis. Use consistent weight (e.g., solid or regular). Example: 'fa-solid fa-calendar', 'fa-solid fa-bars', 'fa-solid fa-user'.

testing.rules: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute in the HTML. Example: `data-testid='dashboard-kpi-revenue'`, `data-testid='booking-row-1234'`, `data-testid='btn-sync-channels'`.

hotel_interior.description: Elegant corridor of a heritage hotel, showcasing architectural charm and luxury design.

guest_avatars.description: Woman in black crew neck shirt

instructions_to_main_agent: This is a pure vanilla HTML/CSS/JS project (PHP backend). DO NOT use React, Tailwind, or Shadcn. Implement these design tokens via pure CSS variables in the existing admin-styles.css file. Use pure vanilla JavaScript (.js files) for the collapsible sidebar, slide-over drawer toggling, and Gantt scrolling. Include FontAwesome CDN in the HTML head. All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.
